verdicts.flaw_description: The purchase figures are measured on a narrower population than the claim: "The counts cover the sessions that reached the new page," while "a quarter of each segment dropped out before checkout" and so never entered the counts. A 4-7 percent rise among the three quarters that reached the new checkout page does not establish that purchases overall increased.

A named alternative cause reaches every unit: "Rainfall in each block's season ran about a fifth above the year before, and every block lay in open ground, under no cover." A 20 percent wetter season falling on uncovered maize blocks could produce the 0.4-0.7 t/ha gains regardless of the drip line.

Two of the four cases have outcome windows that close before the inhaler was started: case One "started 4 March, had 6 fewer attacks by 28 February," and case Three "started 5 September, had 7 fewer attacks by 30 August." Reductions dated before treatment began cannot be attributed to the inhaler.

The measured population is a self-selected subset of the treated one: "Averages cover the patients who kept up the home exercises, and a quarter of each intake let the home exercises lapse." The 9-16 degree gains are averages over compliers only, with the lapsed quarter of each intake dropped, so they do not establish what the protocol does for the intakes it was given to.

An alternative cause covers all four classes: "Class sizes at each school ran about a quarter below the year before, and every logged class took its English lessons as one whole group." Classes a quarter smaller, taught undivided, is a well-known driver of comprehension gains and could account for the 5-9 point rises without the reading program.

The defect rates are computed on a filtered subset of each run: "Rates cover the boards soldered on the new profile throughout, and about a tenth of each run's boards took one pass on the old profile," so roughly 10 percent of every run is excluded from the count it is compared against. A 4-7 percent drop measured on the surviving 90 percent does not establish the profile reduces defects in the run.
